notes.title: Sneak Peek: The Next Big Update
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,
As you know, the game needs major changes, new content, and other improvements. I've been working on a big update for about a month now, but it will take another month or maybe even two to complete.  



The update should be ready in end of summer.


Features in progress for the next update 👷‍♂️📦:


🪴 Grow Shop System
In the next update, the game will start in a small shop that you can expand and build yourself — not by just clicking a "Buy" button, but by actually placing things like walls, roofs, floors, doors, and windows.  You’ll be able to buy building parts from the tablet, place them where you want, and even destroy walls to make more space! 


💰 Auction System
The auction system is getting a full remake! 
Expect a refreshed look for negotiations and loans, along with improvements to how it feels and works. It's not just about the visuals, but also the overall experience, both on paper. 


👥 NPC Improvements
I’m starting the NPC code from scratch because there were too many things to improve. Sometimes starting over is the best way forward! 
With this new approach, NPCs will have better behavior, new interactions, the ability to go to the shop and leave in different ways, and much more! 


🛠️ Tool Improvements
Tools are getting a fresh new look and smoother animations! 
I'm also working on improving how they feel and function, so using them will be more satisfying and intuitive. 


🔄 Recoding & System Overhaul
I’m recoding and remaking some systems to improve the overall feel of the game. The original code had a rough start, but now I’m working on fixing it to make everything run smoother and more enjoyable. 


🛒 New Shelves & Products
I’m adding new shelves and products to work with, maybe including a weapon pack! Expect more options for expanding your store and offering a wider variety of items. 


🛒 Shelf Improvements
Shelves will now improve by snapping to each other, making it easier to organize and expand your store layout! 


🔧🧰 Repair System
In the next update, you’ll be able to fix broken stuff using a repair kit and spare parts. 


🧾↔️ Sell & Buy Point Separation
The sell point and buy point will now be separate and smaller, giving you more flexibility in how you organize your shop. You’ll also be able to move them wherever you want!


⚖️ Price Balance
I’m reworking the prices of all items to make the gameplay more balanced and fair. Expect better pacing and more satisfying progression!


🚀 Performance Optimization
I’m working on improving the game's performance to make everything run more efficiently and smoothly, especially on lower-end setups.


🔧⚙️ Other Improvements & Fixes
Lots of smaller improvements and bug fixes are also being added to make the overall experience better, smoother, and more polished.



Things in the Plan 🔜🚧
These are things I’m planning, but not everything might make it into this update. Some of them could appear in future updates! 


🏢 Store Upgrade
Upgrade your store from the old version to a modern one by purchasing the upgrade through the PC. 


🌐 Internet Features
The internet will act like a marketplace, allowing buying, selling, and even negotiating at auctions! 


🎨 Decoration Items
Expect new decoration items to make your store look even better and more personalized!


🏚️ Separate Storage Building
A new building dedicated only to storage. Perfect for keeping your products, items, or anything else you need organized and out of the way.

notes.title: 📢 Patch 0.50
notes.notes:
Hello everybody, the update has been available for 2 days, but it's now officially out. Some fixes were needed for the update.

If you've played before, take a moment to check out the new changes! If you think the game has improved, consider updating your Steam review – it really helps me!

If you load a old save, the walls will appear as they were before or as old drywall if you haven’t painted them. Also, if you had unlocked some licenses in a save before the update, they will stay unlocked, but you might still see 'To Unlock' displayed.

🛠 General Changes:

Added XP system.
Redesigned bills and licenses (now require XP to unlock).
Refresh bills and license design for a cleaner look.
Reworked pawn shop start – now you begin with a run-down pawn shop that you need to renovate, instead of a brand-new store.
Added a special tutorial map for learning the renovation system.
Reworked tutorial – now clearer, more specific, and much smaller.
Lowered bill prices.
Improved optimization for better performance.
Balanced length of the things to interact with.

🛒 Store & Economy:

Added store levels – unlockable with XP.
Added license store level requirement.
NPCs now buy products between 50% - 100% of their value (anything over 100% is overpriced).
Starting money amount is now $1500.
Added 10 new products.

🤖 NPC Improvements:

Added 4 new NPC models.
NPCs no longer get stuck on shelves.
NPCs update their walking paths inside the shop.
NPCs rotate properly on shelves.
NPCs no longer return to their spawn points after walking.
If all shelves are empty, NPCs now randomly choose where to go.
If one shelf has items and all others are empty, NPCs will go to the shelf with products.
NPCs no longer wander around aimlessly in the shop.

🎮 Gameplay & UI Fixes:

Fixed PC screen not working sometimes.
Improved left help widget to prevent overlapping with other UI elements.
Removed "Much to Pay" widget.
Now, widgets no longer auto-show setting prices after placing a product.
Added item pick-up animations for all objects.
Improved pick-up animations – now smoother and quicker.
Fixed pick-up animation bugs.
Fixed negotiation money issue – no longer gives money before the event starts.
Fixed not being able to grab paint from a can after using a brick.
Fixed negotiation item disappearing when trying to pick it up and drop it.

🏪 Other Fixes & Adjustments:

Closer NPC spawner for better flow.
Fixed unable to sleep between 8-9 AM.
Open/Close sign can now be used from both sides.

🔊 Audio Improvements:

Added negotiation sounds.
Added loan system sounds.

notes.title: Major Update (Patch 0.32)
notes.notes:

Now I plan to release updates weekly. 

To make everything work properly, delete the old save game.


Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/EYtazA6BZa

If you don't see the update, just restart Steam.

notes.title: Patch 0.21
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! 🎉🎊

The game is improving, but it's still not where it should be. If you're disappointed with the current state of the game, I believe it will become much more playable with the new content by the end of January. However, this doesn’t mean there won't be updates in the meantime! 🚀✨

Game
 Added tutorial. 
 Added packing pallet to trash after use (Keybind: Hold F).
 Added restore pack from pallet (Keybinds: Pick up F, place C).
 Improved pallet texture.
 Rebuilt directional light (sun).
 Improved interior lighting inside the pawnshop.
 Added respawn for player if they fall underground.

World
 New lighting.
 Fixed save/load issue where directional sunlight sometimes got stuck, causing the scene to stay dark; the light's position now saves correctly.
 Fixed sun and time synchronization.
 Added static cars (non-moving, non-drivable, just for scenery).

Menu
 Added new main menu.
 Added option to change save name.
 Added game save date display.
 Added mouse sensitivity settings.
 Added more graphics options.
 Added volume settings.
 Improved saving.
 Improved loading.
 Added loading screen.
 Fixed issue where deleting all saves still loaded the last one in every save game.

Widget
 Fixed issue where the Withdraw Widget would freeze the game.
 Improved left-side help widget and added more details.
 Lowered fee prices, and each fee now has its own payment deadline.

NPCs
 Fixed infinite loop where NPCs would walk in circles in the shop.
 Improved NPC leaving behavior and movement.
